stories.headline: McNulty wins the world road race title in Montreal
stories.summary: The elite men's road race closed the cycling world championships in Montreal, Canada. Brandon McNulty of the United States went clear with around 30 kilometres remaining and finished 13 seconds ahead. He beat the Australian Michael Matthews and the Dutch rider Mathieu van der Poel.

stories.headline: Swiss voters reject both of the day's initiatives
stories.summary: Switzerland put two proposals to a public vote on 27 September 2026. One proposed to enshrine a stricter form of Swiss neutrality; the other asked for safe food, through sustainable domestic production, more plant-based foods and clean drinking water. Both were rejected by a wide margin.

stories.headline: Starship reaches orbit and releases 26 satellites
stories.summary: Starship flew for the fourteenth time, and for the first time it reached a sustained orbit. Ship 41 deployed 26 operational Starlink V3 satellites, the first operational payloads Starship has carried. The flight was then cut short, to about two hours in space instead of the eight that planners had intended.
